SKYWEST
METRO
II or III
PASSENGER SAFETY INFORMATION
"NO SMOKING" AND "FASTEN SEAT BELT" SIGNS
NO SMOKING ALLOWED WHEN OXYGEN IN USE
For your safety and comfort, please comply with the "NO SMOKING" and
"FASTEN SEAT BELT" signs wnen they are illuminated. Seat belts should
be fastened securely. As a precaution against unexpected turbulence you
should keep your seat belt fastened at all times while seated.
TO FASTEN:
Insert metal tab into
metal buckle until it
snaps.
TO ADJUST:
Pull end of belt until desired
secureness is obtained.
The altitudes at which the aircraft operates may
require the use of OXYGEN in the event there is
a loss of cabin pressure. Should this occur, a
crew member will notify you.
TO REMOVE:
1. Take the mask which is stowed in your seat
back and prompty insert the hose plug into
OXYGEN outlet receptacle located
A.
Either overhead or
B. Next to seat
2. Place mask over your nose and mouth.
Breathe normally.
insert fingers under buckle
flange and lift upward.
• 3. Adjust headband to hold mask snugly.
4. Wear mask until advised by crew to remove
PLEASE DO NOT REMOVE THIS CARD FROM AIRCRAFT-SEE OTHER SIDE
LOCKED
TURN TO LOCI
LIFE PRESERVER
Life preserves.
if needed, are located under each
seat.
TO PREPARE FOR A LANDING ON WATER:
1. Follow instructions of crew
2. Pull on Life Preserver (see instructions with Life
Preserver).
3. Assume bracing position (see diagram).
4. After plane stops completely. unfasten seat belt.
Follow instructions of crew.
5. After leaving plane, Inflate Life Preserver.
EMERGENCY EXIT OPERATION
PASSENGER DOOR OPERATION
1. Rotate handle in direction of arrow.
2. Push door OUT.
CLOSED
WINDOW EMERGENCY EXIT
1. Grab HATCH HANDLE. Pull handle and entire
hatch INWARD AND UP. clear of opening.
2. Rotate hatch 90° and extend bottom through
opening. Throw hatch outside aircraft.
FIRE
EXTINGUISHER
NORMAL
EXIT
EMERGENCY
EXIT
FIRE
EXTINGUISHER
CAUTION
DO NOT HANDLE OR ATTEMPT TO OPEN THE PASSENGER DOOR
OR WINDOW EMERGENCY EXITS UNLESS THEY ARE TO BE USED
IN AN EMERGENCY.
PLEASE DO NOT REMOVE THIS CARD FROM AIRCRAFT-SEE OTHER SIDE
EMERGENCY
EXIT
